given.note: A number no K-04 handle holds (+15555550199, an example in the 555-01xx range). The gateway's handleSealingKey writes a handle at its first sight, before its text reaches the actor (item 29), so a turn asks for a handle K-04 does not hold only when the record lost it. Every field null: the directory answers null, and no turn or park runs (runtime/src/turn/turn.ts and park.ts: unknownHandle; item 52, default 96).
